subject: mathematics
instructions: Work independently. Show the mathematical steps or representation that support each response.
Check each result before submitting. A response without the requested work may require adult review.

learnerTasks.prompt: Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 39° and ∠B = 51°. Find ∠F.
A rigid motion is a transformation that …
choices: preserves shape but may change size
preserves area but may change side lengths
maps every figure to a similar figure

learnerTasks.prompt: In two triangles, two pairs of corresponding angles and the pair of included sides are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
Two triangles share two pairs of congruent sides and a pair of congruent angles that are not between those sides. Why does this fail to prove congruence?
choices: The angle must be a right angle for any criterion to apply.
Two sides are never enough information under any circumstances.
The unknown side can close the triangle in two different ways, producing one acute and one obtuse triangle from the same measurements.
The triangles are congruent, but the criterion is simply named differently.

learnerTasks.prompt: Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 33° and ∠B = 57°. Find ∠F.
Two figures are congruent if and only if …
choices: there is a sequence of rigid motions taking one exactly onto the other
they can be scaled to match

learnerTasks.prompt: In two triangles, two pairs of corresponding angles and a pair of non-included sides are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
If a sequence of rigid motions maps △ABC onto △DEF, then …
choices: the triangles have equal area but need not be congruent
only the corresponding sides are congruent
only the corresponding angles are congruent
every pair of corresponding sides and angles is congruent

learnerTasks.prompt: Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 62° and ∠B = 29°. Find ∠F.
